question: Which Indian institute introduced two new BTech programs in Computational Engineering and Mechanics and Instrumentation and Biomedical Engineering, starting from the academic year 2025-26?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Technology Madras**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras)** is one of the premier engineering institutions in India, located in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**.
 
• IIT Madras has announced the introduction of two new **BTech programs**, namely **Computational Engineering and Mechanics** and **Instrumentation and Biomedical Engineering**, commencing from the **academic year 2025-26**.
 
• The **Computational Engineering and Mechanics program** focuses on computational tools and their applications in engineering mechanics, which is important for industries like aerospace, automotive, and defense.
 
• The **Instrumentation and Biomedical Engineering program** bridges engineering and medical sciences, focusing on medical instrumentation, diagnostics, and therapeutic technologies.
